thread:
marta: RedProbe confirmed June window. Need quick decisions: RBAC role, KMS access pattern, and evidence retention. Who can take what?

kevin-sre: I can do RBAC. Proposal: role `pt_assessor_ro` with readonly CloudWatch + S3, explicit deny iam:PassRole & ec2:RunInstances, session max 12h. Tag sessions with `pt-session=true` for cleanup.

nina-sec: KMS stance: never grant kms:Decrypt to external accounts. Use an internal decrypt-proxy that returns plaintext to a locked evidence bucket flow and logs every request to CloudTrail. We'll export KMS events to ops account.

devon-eng: For evidence: presigned S3 uploads OK (48h TTL), server-side encrypt with CMK, object-lock governance enabled. We'll attach uploader metadata (report-id, uploader).

evidence-bot: Pre-eng form received: https://forms.example.com/q/xyz. Requested targets: https only, one service account.

marta: Retest rules? propose Jira label `pen-test/needs-retest` + checklist: repro, log clip (with key-id), fix in staging, security signoff.

kevin-sre: I'll open infra-roles PR with policy snippet and assume-role example. Need one quick review from @nina-sec before merge.

nina-sec: Reviewing. Add KMS audit export snippet and note about not allowing raw key access. Also ensure key-id appears in all logs.

devon-eng: I'll create evidence bucket `redwood-pt-redprobe-2026` and post ACLs and presign policy by EOD.

marta: Thanks. Scheduling a 25m tabletop Thurs to walk IR/rollback and readroom access.
